scripts.dev: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev
scripts.build: node scripts/auth-schema.ts check && node scripts/db-schema.ts && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler types && tsc -p . && tsc -p scripts
